collection.description: One sibling saves the last ripe fruit for the other.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: One sibling saves the last ripe fruit for the other. The gesture goes unnoticed by everyone except the sibling.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: One sibling saves the last ripe fruit for the other. They finish laughing about a mistake from earlier in the day.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: One sibling saves the last ripe fruit for the other. The younger child insists on doing the final step independently.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: One sibling saves the last ripe fruit for the other. They disagree about the best method, then try both.
